title: Urd page file (content/pages/*.json)
description: A page: metadata plus a vertical run of sections. Each section is a generic container with a background stack and a free block canvas. The contract is described in docs/SCHEMA.md.

description.description: The page's description (meta description, additive from v0.7); also used as the og:description fallback

og.description: Sharing fields (Open Graph, additive from v0.7); omitted fields fall back to the page title/description/site icon

preset.description: The preset the section was created from - provenance only, controls nothing

theme.description: Ready-made section theme (role set, additive from v0.6): 'surface'/'accent'/'inverse' and others override the theme's color tokens on the section; absence = Standard (no override). Unknown roles are ignored. Norwegian role values from before v3 are lifted by the page migration (ADR-0021).

maxWidth.description: Overrides the site's content width for this section (adopted in v0.7, ADR-0018): CSS length, or 'full' for edge-to-edge content. Absence = inherit site.layout.contentWidth.

grid.description: null = inherit the site's grid; object = override per section

animation.description: Optional entrance animation for the whole section (additive field from v0.5)

hover.description: Optional pointer effect for the whole section (additive field from v0.6) - independent of animation, they can be combined

mode.description: Legacy from schemaVersion 2 (ADR-0019): overrides live per block in frames.mobile. 'manual' is read by the migration, never written again.

attention.description: The mobile-attention flag - editorial metadata, ignored by the visitor engine

decor.description: Decor block: excluded from the entrance animation's content wave. From schemaVersion 2 (ADR-0019) the field controls ONLY animation; the mobile hiding lives in hideMobile.

hideMobile.description: Hide the block on mobile (additive field from v0.7, ADR-0019). Supersedes decor as the mobile filter and applies throughout the mobile render path.

mobileOrder.description: Overrides the sort key in the mobile reading order (interpreted on the same scale as desktop y). Additive field from v0.5: the section templates use it to keep cards together.

sticky.description: Pin on scroll (additive field from v0.6, desktop only): the block is pinned at the top of the viewport and released when its own section (until: null) or a later section (until: section id) has been passed. With mode 'screen' the block instead docks to a fixed point in the viewport for the whole page

offset.description: Distance from the top of the viewport in px while the block is pinned; with mode 'screen' the distance from the docked edges

mode.description: Additive field from v0.7: 'scroll' pins at the top of the viewport when the block is reached and releases at the boundary, 'screen' docks the block in the viewport for the whole page (until does not apply)

dock.description: Additive field from v0.7: the anchor point in the viewport with mode 'screen'

group.description: Additive field from v0.7: blocks with the same group id are pinned and released as one unit and keep their placement relative to each other. The group is controlled by the FIRST member's offset/until/mode/dock

props.description: Type-specific props - owned by the block definition's version/migrations

hover.description: Optional pointer effect (additive field from v0.6) - independent of animation, they can be combined

fit.description: Shrink instead of wrap (additive from v0.7.3, ADR-0024): when the frame is too narrow for the content at full size, the content is zoomed only as much as the design height needs, down to fitMin, and wraps only past it. Omitted = the content wraps and the blocks below are pushed. Desktop only.

fitMin.description: The floor of the shrink as a share of the design size (default 0.6).

mobile.description: Per-block mobile override (ADR-0019): null = the block follows desktop (auto-placed in the row grid); object = partial placement, where only the fields present override. With row the block is pinned to explicit row tracks.

mobilePlacement.description: Partial row-grid placement (ADR-0019). The rows are minmax(8px, auto) and grow with the content, so row/rows are positions in the composition, not frozen pixel distances. Without row the block still flows, and only x/w override.

x.description: Left edge in % of the content surface

w.description: Width in % of the content surface

row.description: Start row (1-based) in the row grid; presence = pinned

rows.description: Row span; absence = derived from the desktop height

frame.description: Physical units: x/w in percent of the section width, y/h in px. The grid is only a snapping tool and never affects placement.

x.description: Left edge in % of the section width

y.description: Top edge in px (can be negative: the block hangs above the section top)

w.description: Width in % of the section width
